name: Favored Sutra (Sutra)
body:
You are exceptionally well-versed in casting a certain sutra.

Choose: A single sutra that you know that has a casting time of 1 round or less.

Benefit: Once per day, you can cast the chosen sutra as a swift action, instead of the type of action that is normally required to cast that sutra.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you gain this feat, it applies to a new sutra.
